svg.title: Choose a plugin release channel and verify consumer use
svg.desc: Test the exact package version and rehearse local installation, listing and removal. A repository marketplace is published as a reviewed commit and tag; workspace publishing has its own roles, and public-directory publication has separate eligibility and review. Verify the consumer's installed version and actual workflow, then retain a tested update, rollback and removal path. This hook-bearing lab is not public-directory eligible unchanged.
